description: Create a campaign AS A DRAFT. There is no tool that sends one: sending puts mail in thousands of real inboxes, spends deliverability reputation that cannot be bought back, and cannot be undone. A person sends it from the dashboard. recipientScope is "all" or a single widget id, and unsubscribed or bounced addresses are excluded automatically.
